limitations: Four targets per family are descriptive development evidence, with no inferential test
Equal-family means do not establish population-level generalization
Exact search/reference is within the finite public catalog, not the full feasible set
Static slice composition regret includes catalog designs already evaluated; it is not remaining-catalog regret

Initial heldout-catalog rankings are matched; selected-outcome RMSE uses different adaptive inputs
Removing orbit covariance A changes the size prior, not the nonlinear composition function class
Known projection principles and a small performance gain do not establish method novelty
SSPd optimizer convergence is unavailable in unchanged source
New catalog objectives and transfer scenarios cannot be compared directly with old unrestricted-runner percentages
The old confirmation40 bank and budgeted-ROI physical validation gap remain separate
